steps: Mash Raspberries roughly with a fork in a small bowl, leaving some chunks.
Whisk Eggs, Ricotta, Cow's milk, and Vanilla extract together in a large bowl.
Add Rice flour and Baking powder to the bowl and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Fold the mashed Raspberries gently into the batter.
Heat Canola oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, about 175 °C (350 °F).
Drop tablespoon-sized rounds of batter into the pan, spacing them 3 cm apart.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and set through, working in batches.
Transfer to a plate and cool slightly before serving. Keep refrigerated for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month.
